items.name: Weddings
items.summary: Honest and thoughtfully composed photography and films that preserve the atmosphere, relationships and meaningful details of your celebration.
items.intro: We cover a wedding the way it actually unfolds. That means arriving early enough to understand the room, staying close to the people who matter, and directing only where it genuinely helps.
includes: Photography, videography, or both
Coverage planned around your run sheet
Preview images within 48 hours
Full edited gallery in one to two weeks
Private download link, active for 90 days
items.audience: Couples who want their day told as one honest story rather than a checklist of poses.
process: A conversation about the day, the people and what matters most to you
A written plan covering locations, timings and the moments you cannot miss
Coverage on the day, working quietly around the celebration
Previews within 48 hours, then the full gallery

faqs.question: How do we check availability?
faqs.answer: Send an enquiry with your date and we will get back to you quickly to confirm.

faqs.question: Do you offer photography and video together?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can book stills, film, or both. Whichever you choose, it is shot by the same team with the same eye.

faqs.question: How long can we access our photos?
faqs.answer: Your photos and films arrive as a private download link that stays active for 90 days, which is plenty of time to download everything and share it with family. After that it is archived. If you need it again later, just ask and we will restore it at no cost.

faqs.question: Do you travel outside Canberra?
faqs.answer: Yes, anywhere in Australia. Travel and accommodation are quoted on top of your package so you can see exactly what they add.

items.name: Events
items.summary: Professional coverage for private celebrations, community gatherings, cultural occasions and corporate events.
items.intro: Events move quickly and rarely repeat themselves. We plan the coverage in advance so the moments that matter are photographed as they happen rather than reconstructed afterwards.
includes: Half or full day coverage
Photography, videography, or both
Preview images within 48 hours
Full edited gallery in one to two weeks
Private download link, active for 90 days
items.audience: Organisers and hosts who need a clean, usable record of their event for marketing or for memory.
process: A short brief covering the run sheet, the venue and who needs to be photographed
Coverage planned around the parts of the programme that matter most
Previews within 48 hours, then the full gallery

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: The earlier the better, especially for weekend dates.

faqs.question: Can you deliver same day highlights?
faqs.answer: Not on the night itself. You will have a set of preview images within 48 hours, and the full edited gallery in one to two weeks.

faqs.question: How long can we access the files?
faqs.answer: Your files arrive as a private download link that stays active for 90 days, so there is time to download and share everything you need. After that it is archived, and we will happily restore it on request.

faqs.question: Do you cover cultural and community events?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly photograph community occasions and take the time to understand the programme and the customs involved beforehand.

includes: Interior and exterior photography
Walkthrough video on request
Aerial stills and video, flown in-house
Delivery within 24 to 48 hours
Private download link, active for 90 days
items.audience: Agents and owners who want listings that stand out and photograph well online.
process: Confirm the property, access and the listing deadline
Shoot the rooms and exterior in the best available light
Edit for accurate colour and straight verticals

faqs.question: Do you shoot drone footage?
faqs.answer: Yes. We fly our own drone, so aerial stills and video can be added to any property shoot.

faqs.question: How quickly can we get images?
faqs.answer: Property images are delivered within 24 to 48 hours, so you can list without waiting.

A shot list agreed before the day
The shoot, on location or at your premises
Delivery in the crops and formats you asked for

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing content packages?
faqs.answer: Not yet. We book shoots individually at the moment, so tell us what you need and we will quote that piece of work.

faqs.question: Can you edit for specific platforms?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can format content for the platforms you use most.
